markdown:
For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://docs.luciq.ai/llms.txt). This page is also available as [Markdown](https://docs.luciq.ai/product-guides-and-integrations/product-guides/ai-features.md).

Luciq's AI features live across the product: Bug Grouping, Opportunities, Survey AI summaries, Detect Agent, Resolve Agent, Release Agent, Luciq Agent, Luciq Lens, Agent Skills, and the Luciq MCP Server. Every AI feature that runs against your workspace's data is toggled from one place, the [**AI Features Control Center**](https://docs.luciq.ai/product-guides-and-integrations/product-guides/ai-features/ai-features-control-center) under **Settings → Workspace**. Only Owners and Admins can change AI feature state; Members and Viewers see it read-only.

The sub-pages below cover each feature in depth.
